name: tree-select
purpose: Form control for choosing one or several nodes of a hierarchy: a combobox-style field (aria-haspopup=tree) whose popup is a Tree View. Typing filters the tree while keeping the paths to matches; Down Arrow moves focus into the tree. Single mode closes on choice; multiple mode uses tri-state checkboxes and shows the values as removable tags. Lazy children, a clear button, required validation, Form integration, and hidden inputs for native submission.
whenToUse: Picking a department, cost center, location, or category from a hierarchy in a form.
Choosing several nodes of a hierarchy where checking a parent means all of its children (permissions, regions).
whenNotToUse: Flat option lists: use Select, Combobox, or Multi Select.
Browsing or editing a hierarchy outside a form: use Tree View.
A cascade of dependent levels shown side by side: use separate Selects.
responsive: Fills the inline size of its container; tags wrap inside the field. The popup matches the field width, flips above the field when there is no room below, and limits its height to the available space.
rtl: The field, tags, and buttons follow the writing direction; the tree in the popup mirrors its indentation and arrow keys.
theme: Component tokens tree-select-radius, -bg, -border-color, -padding-x, -height, -popup-radius, -popup-shadow, -tag-bg, and -tag-radius; the tree uses the Tree View tokens. Invalid fields use color-error-fg; forced colors keep boundaries visible.
security: Labels are rendered as text; hidden inputs carry node ids as values. No HTML is parsed.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. loadChildren is the application's own function (with an AbortSignal).

budgets.budget: visible rows + 2 x overscan + 1 (virtualized Tree View)

performance.testedScale: 10,000 nodes (the popup tree is virtualized); multiple values tested with 200 tags.

limitations: Filtering searches loaded nodes only; lazy children are searched after they are loaded.
A selected id whose node is not loaded shows its valueLabels entry, or the id itself.
Multiple mode with cascade stores every checked id (parents and children); tags show the topmost fully checked node.
unsupported: Free-text values that are not nodes.
Choosing parents only or leaves only in multiple mode (filter the value in aui-change).
antiPatterns: Hiding the label: the visible label is the accessible name.
Using Tree Select for a flat list of a few options: Select is faster to use.
